BREAKING: The FAA proposed three new rules today that could help SpaceX fly Starship more often.

• More flexibility in flight: 
Operators could turn a rocket’s abort system off for one phase and back on later if FAA safety conditions are met.

• Clearer rules for mandatory aborts:
The FAA would clarify how operators assess public risk to determine when a flight must be aborted.

• A new way to assess reentry debris:
Operators could account for how a vehicle breaks apart during an uncontrolled reentry to show that debris is unlikely to cause multiple casualties in one incident.

• One final rule makes minor technical corrections to existing commercial space regulations.

• The FAA is hiring aerospace engineers to speed up license reviews and plans to begin a full licensing overhaul in 2027.

October’s package focused largely on licensing paperwork. Today’s proposals cover flight aborts and reentry safety.

6. Once you apply these filters, you will be left with only a few coins that satisfy the criteria, making it easy to choose the right assets.

7. Once you’ve fully internalised the above and immerse yourself into the community of the asset, you will be able to cultivate the kind of conviction required to hold an asset for several years and to make life-changing wealth.
